prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, and preferred working style. Instead of one name, here’s a practical way to find the best fit plus concrete next steps I can help with.

What matters when choosing an agency
- Relevant experience: successes in your industry or with similar business models (B2B vs B2C, ecommerce, lead generation, etc.)
- Channel expertise: SEO, PPC, social, email, content, web development — make sure they excel at the channels you need
- Measurable results: case studies that show ROI (revenue, leads, conversion rate improvements), not just vanity metrics
- Reporting and transparency: clear KPIs, reporting cadence, access to analytics, and communication norms
- Team & continuity: who will work on your account day-to-day, senior oversight, turnover history
- Tools & processes: preferred ad platforms, CMS, automation and analytics stack
- Budget & pricing model: flat fee, percent of ad spend, performance-based, minimums
- Cultural fit & responsiveness: speed of communication and working style
- References & reviews: client references and third-party reviews (Clutch, Google, LinkedIn)

Key questions to ask potential agencies
1. Can you share case studies for clients like me and measurable outcomes?
2. Which channels would you prioritize and why?
3. Who will be on my team and what are their roles?
4. How do you measure success — which KPIs?
5. How often do you report and what will the report include?
6. What is your pricing model and typical monthly budget range for companies like ours?
7. Do you require a minimum contract length or ad spend?
8. Which tools and platforms do you use?
9. Can you provide client references I can contact?
10. How do you handle creative/content production and approvals?

A simple evaluation process
1. Make a short list (5–7) from Clutch, Google, LinkedIn, and local referrals.
2. Send an RFP or brief describing goals, budget, and timeline.
3. Do 30–60 minute discovery calls with top candidates.
4. Check references and review case studies.
5. Start with a small paid pilot or 90-day test project before committing long term.

If you want, I can:
- Shortlist 5–7 St. Louis agencies tailored to your needs (I’ll use current directories and reviews)
- Draft an RFP or outreach email you can send
- Create a comparison matrix to evaluate proposals

Tell me: what are your main goals (SEO, lead gen, ecommerce sales, brand awareness), your monthly marketing budget (approx.), and whether you’re B2B or B2C — I’ll put together a tailored shortlist and next steps.
